metadata.title: 据报道Claude再签350亿美元算力大单：谁在替AI需求承担风险？
metadata.titleEn: Behind Claude’s Reported $35 Billion Compute Deal: Who Actually Bears the Risk?
metadata.summary: Reuters据一位知情来源报道Anthropic与Lambda的350亿美元云合同，期限、容量与地点未披露。以Hut 8 Beacon Point为独立对照，追踪需求、云服务、租约、项目债与抵押品之间的风险传导，解释为何长期合同和非追索结构不等于风险消失。
metadata.summaryEn: Reuters attributes a $35 billion Anthropic–Lambda agreement to one source, without disclosing term, capacity or location. A separate Beacon Point financing case shows how cloud demand, leases, project debt and collateral allocate different risks across the infrastructure chain.

counts.method: Body = opening + section paragraphs + conclusion; excludes headings, hero, thesis, sources, links, tables, ledger and disclosure. Han script characters; English alphanumeric words.

review.sourceSummaryBudget: Five sources summarized briefly; long-form body consists primarily of original conditional cash-flow, construction and counterparty analysis. No repeated media story expanded into asserted deal terms.
